PUNJAB PROTECTED AREAS RULES, 2022
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary,
30th September, 2022]
No.
SOP(WL)12-1/2019(P-I), dated 30.9.2022.---In exercise of the powers conferred under section 32 of the Punjab
Protected Areas Act 2020 (XXIII of 2020), Governor of the Punjab is pleased to
make the following rules:
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1)
These rules may be cited as the Punjab Protected Areas Rules, 2022.
(2) They
shall come into force at once.
2. Definitions.---(1) In the rules, unless the context or subject
requires otherwise:
(a) "Act"
means the Punjab Protected Areas Act, 2020 (XXIII of 2020);
(b) "Director
General" means the Director General (Wildlife and Parks), Punjab;
(c) "rules"
means the Punjab Protected Areas Rules, 2022; and
(d) "Schedule"
means the Schedule appended to the rules.
(2) A
word or expression used but not defined in the rules shall have the same meaning
as assigned to it in the Act.
3. Eligibility
and terms and conditions of non-official members of the Board.---(1) A non-official member of the Board shall:
(a) not
be less than forty years of age;
(b) have
active membership in the Chamber of Commerce;
(c) have
no criminal record, including illegal hunting; and
(d) disclose,
if he or his relative is concerned or interested, directly or indirectly, in
any management agreement of a protected area.
(2) The
wildlife expert appointed as non-official member under clause (f) of subsection
(2) of section 4 of the Act shall have at least fifteen years of experience as
wildlife expert and has demonstrated leadership roles in wildlife management
and conservation.
(3) The
environmental expert appointed as non-official member under clause (f) of
subsection (2) of section 4 of the Act shall have a post graduate degree in
environment studies from a university recognized by the Higher Education
Commission and demonstrated advocacy for environment protection preferably in
Pakistan for a period not less than fifteen years.
(4) A
non-official member shall be entitled to an allowance for attending a meeting
of the Board as determined by the Government.
4. Business
of Board.---(1) The Board shall
meet at least once, in every quarter.
(2) The
quorum for the meeting shall be seven members, including at least three
non-official members.
(3) The
decision of the Board shall be made by the vote of majority of its members
present and voting and in case of equality of votes, the Chairperson shall have
the casting vote.
(4) The
Secretary of the Board shall issue notice of meeting including the agenda
approved by the Chairperson, at least seven days before the meeting. In case of
urgency, an agenda may be tabled during the meeting with approval of the
Chairperson.
(5) The
Secretary of the Board shall record minutes of the meeting and circulate them
amongst the members by specifying the time for communication of their opinion.
If, no response is received from a member within the specified time, it shall
be deemed to have been consented or approved by such member.
5. Organization
as management authority.---(1) The
organization interested for the purposes of management of a protected area may
in response to an Expression of Interest or otherwise submits a proposal for
entering into a management agreement to the Director General.
(2) A
proposal referred under sub-rule (1) shall contain:
(a) management
plan fulfilling the requirements provided under subsection (4) of section 15 of
the Act;
(b) environment
management plan;
(c) business
plan ;
(d) infrastructure
development plan;
(e) tourism
development plan; and
(f) institutional
development plan.
(3) For
the purpose of development of management plan, the organization may, with the
prior approval of the Board, enter into a protected area for baseline surveys
before submission of management plan.
